question_text: A vehicle with flashing blue lights and siren sounding is approaching you from the rear. What is the right course of action now?

options.text: I drive over to the right-side as far as possible

correct_answers.text: I drive over to the right-side as far as possible

comment: The vehicle must be given free access. Therefore, you must reduce your speed and drive as far as possible to the side of the road so that the vehicle with blue flashing lights can continue its way unhindered.
